entries.task_id: yi watsi|tare|da raina ‘yancin xan’adam
entries.description: yi watsi tare da raina ‘yancin xan’adam
entries.subject: yi watsi
entries.object: da raina ‘yancin xan’adam

spans.text: Idan har aka yi watsi tare da raina ‘yancin xan’adam, hakan zai iya haifar da halayen ta’addanci waxanda za su mamaye tunanin al’umma.

entries.description: Xinkin Duniya sun jaddada imaninsu kan muhimman haqqoqin xan’adam da suka haxa da ganin qima da daraja da bayar da daidaitacciyar dama tsakanin maza da mata da tabbatar da bunqasar cigaba da kuma samar da kyakkyawar rayuwa
entries.subject: Xinkin Duniya
entries.object: jaddada imaninsu kan muhimman haqqoqin xan’adam da suka haxa da ganin qima da daraja da bayar da daidaitacciyar dama tsakanin maza da mata da tabbatar da bunqasar cigaba da kuma samar da kyakkyawar rayuwa

spans.text: Mutanen da ke cikin Majalisar Xinkin Duniya sun jaddada imaninsu kan muhimman haqqoqin xan’adam da suka haxa da ganin qima da daraja da bayar da daidaitacciyar dama tsakanin maza da mata da tabbatar da bunqasar cigaba da kuma samar da kyakkyawar rayuwa.

entries.task_id: xinkin duniya|tare|da haxin gwiwar majalisar
entries.description: Xinkin Duniya tare da haxin gwiwar majalisar
entries.subject: Xinkin Duniya
entries.object: da haxin gwiwar majalisar

spans.text: Haka nan qasashen da ke cikin Majalisar Xinkin Duniya tare da haxin gwiwar majalisar, sun xauki alqawarin bunqasa tare da samar da dukkan abubuwan da suka shafi kiyaye haqqoqin xan’adam.

entries.task_id: alqawarin bunqasa|tare|da samar da dukkan abubuwan da suka shafi kiyaye haqqoqin xan’adam
entries.description: alqawarin bunqasa tare da samar da dukkan abubuwan da suka shafi kiyaye haqqoqin xan’adam
entries.subject: alqawarin bunqasa
entries.object: da samar da dukkan abubuwan da suka shafi kiyaye haqqoqin xan’adam

spans.text: Haka nan qasashen da ke cikin Majalisar Xinkin Duniya tare da haxin gwiwar majalisar, sun xauki alqawarin bunqasa tare da samar da dukkan abubuwan da suka shafi kiyaye haqqoqin xan’adam.

entries.task_id: abin da|ya|sa a ka yi tunanin gabatar da wannan qudiri
entries.description: abin da ya sa a ka yi tunanin gabatar da wannan qudiri
entries.subject: abin da
entries.object: sa a ka yi tunanin gabatar da wannan qudiri

spans.text: Fahimtar waxannan haqqoqi da sanin ‘yanci shi ne babban muhimmin abin da ya sa a ka yi tunanin gabatar da wannan qudiri.

entries.task_id: xinkin duniya|ya|yi shelar waxannan dokoki na kare haqqin dan’adam a duniya
entries.description: Xinkin Duniya ya yi Shelar Waxannan Dokoki Na Kare Haqqin Dan’adam a Duniya
entries.subject: Xinkin Duniya
entries.object: yi Shelar Waxannan Dokoki Na Kare Haqqin Dan’adam a Duniya

spans.text: Babban Zauren Majalisar Xinkin Duniya ya yi Shelar Waxannan Dokoki Na Kare Haqqin Dan’adam a Duniya.

entries.task_id: mutum da|ya|kiyaye wannan quduri (dokokin ‘yanci) tare da sanya shi a ransa da kuma yin jihadi ta hanyar koyarwa da ilmantarwa domin a kiyaye waxannan haqqoqi da ‘yanci
entries.description: mutum da ya kiyaye wannan quduri (dokokin ‘yanci) tare da sanya shi a ransa da kuma yin jihadi ta hanyar koyarwa da ilmantarwa domin a kiyaye waxannan haqqoqi da ‘yanci
entries.subject: mutum da
entries.object: kiyaye wannan quduri (dokokin ‘yanci) tare da sanya shi a ransa da kuma yin jihadi ta hanyar koyarwa da ilmantarwa domin a kiyaye waxannan haqqoqi da ‘yanci

spans.text: Majalisar ta amince da cewa domin samar da cigaba ga dukkan al’umma, an buqaci kowanne mutum da ya kiyaye wannan quduri (dokokin ‘yanci) tare da sanya shi a ransa da kuma yin jihadi ta hanyar koyarwa da ilmantarwa domin a kiyaye waxannan haqqoqi da ‘yanci.

Idan mutum ya ga za a aikata abin da zai hana shi haqqoqinsa ko ‘yancinsa da tsarin mulki ko dokar qasa ta tanadar masa, yana da damar kai qara gaban kotun musamman da qasarsa ta tanada domin yin hakan.

entries.task_id: domin|ya|zamana an samu manufa ta bai-xaya
entries.description: domin ya zamana an samu manufa ta bai-xaya
entries.subject: domin
entries.object: zamana an samu manufa ta bai-xaya

spans.text: Haka kuma a bi duk wasu hanyoyin cigaba da ake da su domin a yaxa wannan qudiri tun daga mataki na qasa da matakin qasa da qasa da ma duniya baki xaya, domin ya zamana an samu manufa ta bai-xaya.

entries.task_id: ba|tare|da nuna wani bambanci ba
entries.description: ba tare da nuna wani bambanci ba
entries.subject: ba
entries.object: da nuna wani bambanci ba

spans.text: Kowa na da damar cin moriyar waxannan dokokin na‘yancin xan’adam, ba tare da nuna wani bambanci ba, kamar qabilanci da bambancin launin fata da na jinsi da na harshe da na addini da na siyasa ko kuma wani ra’ayi ko matsayi da ke da alaqa da qasar mutum ko wata qasar, mai ‘yanci ko marar ‘yanci, ko ma qarqashin kowanne irin mulki.

entries.task_id: da rayuwa|tare|da cikakken ‘yanci da samun tsaro na rayuka da dukiya
entries.description: da rayuwa tare da cikakken ‘yanci da samun tsaro na rayuka da dukiya
entries.subject: da rayuwa
entries.object: da cikakken ‘yanci da samun tsaro na rayuka da dukiya

spans.text: Kowanne mutum na da damar gudanar da rayuwa tare da cikakken ‘yanci da samun tsaro na rayuka da dukiya.

entries.task_id: duk inda|ya|sami kansa
entries.description: duk inda ya sami kansa
entries.subject: duk inda
entries.object: sami kansa

spans.text: Doka ta ba wa kowa damar cin moriyar zamansa mutum, a duk inda ya sami kansa.

entries.task_id: bambanci wanda|ya|sava wa waxannan dokoki
entries.description: bambanci wanda ya sava wa waxannan dokoki
entries.subject: bambanci wanda
entries.object: sava wa waxannan dokoki

spans.text: Sannan kuma kowa na da kariyar shari’a a kan kowane nau’in bambanci wanda ya sava wa waxannan dokoki

entries.task_id: kowa don|ya|kare kansa dangane da laifukan da ake tuhumarsa
entries.description: kowa don ya kare kansa dangane da laifukan da ake tuhumarsa
entries.subject: kowa don
entries.object: kare kansa dangane da laifukan da ake tuhumarsa

spans.text: Kowa na da ‘yancin a daidaita shi da kowa a lokutan zaman kotu, kuma a ba shi dama domin a saurare shi a gaban kowa don ya kare kansa dangane da laifukan da ake tuhumarsa.

entries.task_id: ba kafin|ya|aikata
entries.description: ba kafin ya aikata
entries.subject: ba kafin
entries.object: aikata

spans.text: Babu wanda za a kama da aikata kuskure ko laifi in har dokar qasa ko ta duniya ba ta zartar da shi a matsayin laifi ba kafin ya aikata.

entries.task_id: abin da|ya|shafe shi ko iyalansa ko gidansa ko kuma kevantattun abubuwansa
entries.description: abin da ya shafe shi ko iyalansa ko gidansa ko kuma kevantattun abubuwansa
entries.subject: abin da
entries.object: shafe shi ko iyalansa ko gidansa ko kuma kevantattun abubuwansa

spans.text: Babu wanda za a yi wa katsalandan ko leqen asirin abin da ya shafe shi ko iyalansa ko gidansa ko kuma kevantattun abubuwansa.

entries.task_id: da cewa|ya|aikata munanan laifuka na siyasa ko kuma wani laifi da ya sava wa dokokin majalisar xinkin duniya
entries.description: da cewa ya aikata munanan laifuka na siyasa ko kuma wani laifi da ya sava wa dokokin Majalisar Xinkin Duniya
entries.subject: da cewa
entries.object: aikata munanan laifuka na siyasa ko kuma wani laifi da ya sava wa dokokin Majalisar Xinkin Duniya

spans.text: Wannan ‘yancin ba zai hana a tuhumi mutum ba matuqar an tabbatar da cewa ya aikata munanan laifuka na siyasa ko kuma wani laifi da ya sava wa dokokin Majalisar Xinkin Duniya.

entries.task_id: xanqasa ba|tare|da qwaqqwaran dalili ba
entries.description: xanqasa ba tare da qwaqqwaran dalili ba
entries.subject: xanqasa ba
entries.object: da qwaqqwaran dalili ba

spans.text: Babu wanda za a qwace wa ‘yancinsa na zama xanqasa ba tare da qwaqqwaran dalili ba, haka ba za a hana shi damar canza qasa ba, idan yana so.

entries.task_id: hayayyafa ba|tare|da la’akari da bambancin launin fata ko na qasa ko kuma na addini ba
entries.description: hayayyafa ba tare da la’akari da bambancin launin fata ko na qasa ko kuma na addini ba
entries.subject: hayayyafa ba
entries.object: da la’akari da bambancin launin fata ko na qasa ko kuma na addini ba

spans.text: Maza da mata da suka balaga suna da ‘yancin auren duk wanda suke so, kuma su hayayyafa ba tare da la’akari da bambancin launin fata ko na qasa ko kuma na addini ba.

entries.task_id: dukiya ba|tare|da hakki ba
entries.description: dukiya ba tare da hakki ba
entries.subject: dukiya ba
entries.object: da hakki ba

spans.text: Babu wanda za a qwace wa dukiya ba tare da hakki ba.

entries.task_id: yake so|tare|da bayar da gaskiya da shi
entries.description: yake so tare da bayar da gaskiya da shi
entries.subject: yake so
entries.object: da bayar da gaskiya da shi

spans.text: Kowanne mutum na da ‘yancin yin tunani a kan kansa, yana kuma da ‘yancin bin addinin da yake so tare da bayar da gaskiya da shi, shi kaxai ko cikin haxaka, a voye ko a bayyane.

entries.task_id: wannan addini|ya|yi umarni
entries.description: wannan addini ya yi umarni
entries.subject: wannan addini
entries.object: yi umarni

spans.text: Yana kuma da damar gudanar da dukkanin abubuwan da wannan addini ya yi umarni.

entries.task_id: yanci kuwa|ya|hana a yi masa shisshigi kan wannan ra’ayi nasa
entries.description: yanci kuwa ya hana a yi masa shisshigi kan wannan ra’ayi nasa
entries.subject: yanci kuwa
entries.object: hana a yi masa shisshigi kan wannan ra’ayi nasa

spans.text: Kowanne mutum yana da ‘yancin bayyana ra’ayinsa; wannan ‘yanci kuwa ya hana a yi masa shisshigi kan wannan ra’ayi nasa, yana kuma da damar nema da karva da kuma fitar da duk wasu bayanai ta hanyar amfani da kafofin yaxa labarai ba tare da yin iyaka ba.

spans.text: Idan har aka yi watsi tare da raina ‘yancin xan’adam, hakan zai iya haifar da halayen ta’addanci waxanda za su mamaye tunanin al’umma.

fold.statement: a sidecar is never done (LP8): layers append, the fold is recomputed on every append
fold.note: adversarial layers append when a lexicon ring or an adjudicator reaches this language

surprise.definition: things are surprising to the extent they change our hypergraph, not ngram frequency (user direction, verbatim — LP7 amendment 2026-08-31). Surprise is the TYPED CHANGE an increment makes to the accumulated graph, never a perplexity.

structural.note: every expected article region present — the skeleton is corroborated, near-zero surprise
